sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This justification authorizes and dictates the acquisition of specific, brand-name industrial automation, network, and scanning hardware—specifically Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) network switches, Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley control platforms, and Datalogic industrial scanners—necessary to support the deployment, integration, and sustainment of the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Material Flow System (MFS). The requirement for these specific manufacturers is based entirely on the technical parameters of the existing solution and the DLA Enterprise Approved Architecture, not on subjective vendor preference. Standardizing on these chosen enterprise brands is operationally necessary to align long-term sustainment, configuration management, and maintenance processes. Utilizing non-standard hardware would introduce disparate system architectures, exponentially increasing lifecycle maintenance costs and degrading operational readiness by disrupting the required interoperability across the physical and digital layers of DLA's critical material-handling infrastructure. sla_onsite.text: Background: AFIT does not have a complete system for safely controlling the flow of gases into lab 640/275, venting the gas lines in the event of an emergency, nor is the exhaust rated or matched in capacity for research projects. Due to the explosive nature of the gases in use, it is important to design safety features integrated into the delivery system and then match the expected exhaust volumes, and balance them with the CE values for air conditioning at the building level of the system. II. Minimum Technical Requirements: The following are the minimum requirements/tasks: A. General requirements a. Complete a comprehensive on-site survey for analysis of all work i. Minimum capacities equivalent to current lab capacities except where noted below b. Comply with all current safety, design, and construction regulations i.
